comments.author: Caleb
comments.html:
Dude, your comics still somehow manage to fill me with that inexplicable feeling of angst and understanding, all whilst avoiding blatant nihilism.

You’re honestly my favorite webcomic writer around.

Keep it up, don’t kill yourself, I’m reading.

<3

comments.html: Another update so soon? I’d say I was overjoyed, but somehow I don’t feel like that’s appropriate for this comic.

yup, what Caleb said.

comments.html:

comments.html: this entire comic hit me in a deep place. I’m just barely out of this type of vicious cycle, but it’s comforting to see it represented so clearly. Thank you
